theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks, Bonds to Drop on Oil, Inflation Woes: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks and bonds were set for declines after a surge in oil prices sparked a selloff in US markets, while the latest inflation data reinforced bets on an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike.

top_news.title: Treasury Yields Surge as Oil, Buyback Results Fuel Selloff
top_news.summary: The US bond-market selloff accelerated on Thursday as spiking oil prices fanned inflation fears and the Treasury Department bought fewer bonds than expected during its first expanded buyback operation.

top_news.title: The Rise of Organized Retail Crime at Big Box Stores
top_news.summary: If you walk into a local pharmacy in New York City, more likely than not, lots of the merchandise is locked behind closed doors as a measure to mitigate shoplifting. So how big is the "retail shrink" problem really? And why are stores willing to sacrifice customer experience to protect their inventory? top_news.title: NSE Downsizes India IPO, Showing Mounting Valuation Concern
top_news.summary: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd., the world’s largest derivatives exchange by volume, has downsized its initial public offering, a sign of rising concern over the willingness of investors to buy into the deal at the valuation the firm had been seeking.

top_news.title: Philip Morris CEO Is ‘Optimistic’ About Zyn Potential
top_news.summary: Jacek Olczak discusses Zyn's strong demand and asking whether those issues have now been resolved. The conversation also focused on Philip Morris International’s year-end market share target for Zyn and whether offering larger cans with 15 to 20 pouches could boost revenue as well as margins. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: FanDuel CEO on Sports Betting
top_news.summary: Christian Genetski, President of FanDuel discusses the business of sports betting with Bloomberg’s Scarlet Fu at Bloomberg Power Players 2026 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Municipal Bond Yields Soar to Highest Since 2011 in Rout
top_news.summary: Municipal bond yields jumped as much as 15 basis points with the longest-dated securities reaching the highest since 2011, as rising Treasury rates and heavy new issuance pressure the market.

top_news.title: Stocks, Bonds Drop as Oil Spike Boosts Fed Wagers: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Another rally in oil prices spurred losses in stocks and bonds, with the latest inflation data reinforcing bets the Federal Reserve will increase rates soon amid pressures from higher energy costs.

top_news.title: US Yields at Multiyear Highs Bring Buyers to 30-Year Auction
top_news.summary: Yields on US government debt rose to fresh multiyear highs — stoking demand for an auction of 30-year bonds — as surging oil prices bolstered the case for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike as soon as next week.

top_news.title: Yankees, Vanderbilt on the Evolution of College Sports
top_news.summary: Randy Levine, President, New York Yankees and Candice Storey Lee, Vice Chancellor for Athletics and University Affairs and Athletic Director at Vanderbilt University discuss the evolving college sports landscape with Bloomberg’s Janet Lorin at Bloomberg Power Players 2026 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
